verses.english: “Mendicants, give up the unskillful.
It is possible to give up the unskillful.

verses.pali: No cedaṁ, bhikkhave, sakkā abhavissa akusalaṁ pajahituṁ, nāhaṁ evaṁ vadeyyaṁ:
verses.english: If it wasn’t possible, I wouldn’t say:
‘Give up the unskillful.’

verses.pali: Yasmā ca kho, bhikkhave, sakkā akusalaṁ pajahituṁ tasmāhaṁ evaṁ vadāmi:
verses.english: But it is possible, and so I say:
‘Give up the unskillful.’

verses.pali: Akusalañca hidaṁ, bhikkhave, pahīnaṁ ahitāya dukkhāya saṁvatteyya nāhaṁ evaṁ vadeyyaṁ:
verses.english: And if giving up the unskillful led to harm and suffering, I would not say:
‘Give up the unskillful.’

verses.pali: Yasmā ca kho, bhikkhave, akusalaṁ pahīnaṁ hitāya sukhāya saṁvattati tasmāhaṁ evaṁ vadāmi:
verses.english: But giving up the unskillful leads to welfare and happiness, so I say:
‘Give up the unskillful.’
Mendicants, develop the skillful.
It is possible to develop the skillful.

verses.pali: No cedaṁ, bhikkhave, sakkā abhavissa kusalaṁ bhāvetuṁ, nāhaṁ evaṁ vadeyyaṁ:
verses.english: If it wasn’t possible, I wouldn’t say:
‘Develop the skillful.’

verses.pali: Yasmā ca kho, bhikkhave, sakkā kusalaṁ bhāvetuṁ tasmāhaṁ evaṁ vadāmi:
verses.english: But it is possible, and so I say:
‘Develop the skillful.’

verses.pali: Kusalañca hidaṁ, bhikkhave, bhāvitaṁ ahitāya dukkhāya saṁvatteyya, nāhaṁ evaṁ vadeyyaṁ:
verses.english: If developing the skillful led to harm and suffering I wouldn’t say:
‘Develop the skillful.’

verses.pali: Yasmā ca kho, bhikkhave, kusalaṁ bhāvitaṁ hitāya sukhāya saṁvattati tasmāhaṁ evaṁ vadāmi:
verses.english: But developing the skillful leads to welfare and happiness, so I say:
‘Develop the skillful.’”
